mapper.select: select log_id, user_id, user_name, operation, module, target_id, detail, ip, create_time from ee_audit_log where log_id = #{logId}
mapper.insert: insert into ee_audit_log(user_id, user_name, operation, module, target_id, detail, ip, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{userName}, #{operation}, #{module}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{ip}, now())
